entries.en: to ask; to inquire.
to visit; to call on and inquire after.
entries.notes: M 栏「hong inguiindo」尾部标 T99 污损、音写不全并夹西语动词残形，语义仅由 H「訪」与 L preguntar 定。

entries.en: to ask the reason for something; to investigate.
to examine into; to investigate the cause.
to pay a visit; to call on (to ask after someone).
to ask after someone's health; to pay one's respects.
to inquire respectfully; to send greetings.

entries.zh: 借问；请问（客气的问询套语）。
entries.en: to ask politely ("may I ask"); to make inquiry.
entries.notes: L 栏沿用 preguntar por su salud，与 H「借問」的请问套语不完全对应，取通行义。

entries.zh: 尊恙（敬称对方病况）；探问病情。
entries.en: (polite) your illness; to inquire after an invalid.
entries.notes: H 为敬称名词，L 为「问病人安否」动词短语，释义取二者交集。

entries.zh: 所问之事；被问及的内容。
entries.en: that which is asked; the matter inquired about.

entries.zh: 相会；相见（互问乡里、消息而相识）。
entries.en: to meet one another; to come together (and learn each other's origins).
entries.notes: L 栏含 [疑] 读法（patrias/noticias），H「相會」只落「相见」义，语境义据 L 补足。

entries.en: to ask Your Mercy; "may I ask you".
to inquire; to ask.
to visit; to call upon.
entries.notes: M 栏末「ingiriendo」形似西语动词残形（参第 2 条 inguiindo），疑非闽南语转写。

entries.en: to remonstrate indirectly; to admonish by allusion.
entries.notes: L 作 preguntar，与 H「諷諫」的劝谏义不合，从 H 定释。

entries.zh: 长老；修院首长（院长／会长）。
entries.en: elder; prelate (superior) of a convent.
entries.notes: M 栏「sioⁿ lo: tiang lo」为同一词头的两种音写叠记，原稿重出；Prelado 指修院首长。

entries.en: to requite; to recompense.
to reward; to bestow a reward; to recompense.

entries.zh: 封；封赠（因子孙为官而受朝廷封典）。
entries.en: to confer a title or patent of honor (upon a parent, by favor of a mandarin son).
entries.notes: L 栏「R.e」缩写不明（疑为 P.re「父」或 Rey），封赠对象据 17 世纪封典制度推补。

entries.en: to inherit (a title or office); to succeed to the father's post.
